messages:
Maya: Quick sync — Bluegrain private/VPC dry-run finished. Post-run notes: CIDR overlap, KMS key policy denied our service, and audit-forwarding to their Splunk failed. Need triage and owners.
Ravi: On it — can you paste the exact VPC CIDR they tried to use? I'll check route tables and peering options.
Maya: They sent 10.0.0.0/16; our default templates expect 10.1.0.0/16. They say they cannot change it. Renewal risk: legal flagged potential isolation issue if we can't provide a clean private network. :frowning:
Jules: If they can't renumber, options are: carve out non-overlapping subnets on our side, or set up a translation/proxy (SNAT) layer. Both add complexity and probably cost. Low-latency apps might suffer.
Sam (Platform): Suggest we open an infra ticket for the workaround + cost delta. I'll pick it up if approved.
Maya: Please do. Also KMS: their security team wants to use a customer-managed CMK and deny decrypts to account root. Our template currently references `arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service`. Error observed: `AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key xyz`.
Jules: We can support customer-managed keys, but we need the role ARN they want us to use (and that role must allow our service to assume it). Ask them for `arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNTID:role/RoleName`.
Maya: They provided `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Bluegrain-Redwood-Access` but their trust policy doesn't allow `sts:AssumeRole` from our principal. @Ravi can you paste the minimal trust policy we need?
Ravi: Minimal cross-account trust policy (copy to customer):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```
bluegrain-sysbot: New ticket created: INF-5869 (network workaround) assigned to Sam. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5869
Sam (Platform): Assigned. I'll draft a runbook, include a cost estimate for SNAT/proxy and call out latency delta. Will also require security signoff for CMK changes.
Maya: Audit logs: their Splunk ingestion path uses Kinesis Firehose; forwarding attempts returned 403s. @audit-bot can you show the latest forward attempt payload/error?
audit-bot: Forward attempt 2026-03-20T14:02Z failed with 403. Error: AccessDenied for role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Bluegrain-Splunk-Ingest`. Logs: /var/log/forwarder/2026-03-20.log
Jules: They need an IAM policy on that role allowing `firehose:PutRecord` and `logs:PutLogEvents` scoped to their delivery stream and log group ARNs. I'll paste a minimal policy into INF-5869.
Maya: Heads-up — customer flagged this as a blocker for renewal conversation next week. Can we mark P0 and do an internal sync Thu EOD to confirm fixes before I update them?
Sam (Platform): Marked priority: P0. Scheduling internal sync Thu 17:00 PT. @darren (CS Lead) please join — need renewal/contract context.
darren (CS Lead): On calendar. I'll prepare a brief for legal/renewal folks and capture any non-negotiable requirements.
Maya: Thanks team — I'll collate answers and paste a concise status update into the customer handoff doc after the Thursday sync. :thumbsup:
